Configure training-time waveform augmentation before feature extraction.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Blocked): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Blocked because the current graph noise_level contract is amplitude-like while the backend AddNoise helper expects SNR dB. Time-stretch and pitch-shift ranges are also hardcoded and lack deterministic node-level policy.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Augmentation | Noise level | `noise_level` | Number | `0.01` | `>=0` | The run | Requested additive-noise control; units are not yet aligned with the backend helper. |
| Augmentation | Time stretch | `time_stretch` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Enable bounded random time stretching. |
| Augmentation | Pitch shift | `pitch_shift` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Enable bounded random pitch shifting. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
